title: Schema: add required summary and part-of to kt
close_reason: summary required, part-of added (validation, get parts, merge/rm, gaps ignores). 35 tests pass. Live KB backfilled in ~/.claude/knowledge 829ac71.

notes.author: Dylan Wichman/5e2bceba
notes.text: Design: summary = required string, the black-box line (what goes in, what comes out, when it is used, without naming parts). part-of = list of ids, same rules as requires (resolve, no self, acyclic in its own graph); an id may not appear in both requires and part-of of one record. kt get shows inverse 'parts'. merge/rm rewrite part-of like requires. gaps ignores part-of (parts are not prerequisites). Backfill the live KB in the same session, because kt on PATH is the working tree.
